title: My ESP32 guards the cookie jar

lines.text: Someone keeps stealing my cookies. So I built a guard.
I arm it, and I have ten seconds to leave.
A hand sneaks in... and the siren goes off.
When I come back, it even tells me when: two minutes ago.
The white dome is a motion sensor. It sees warmth, through many little windows.
Something warm moves from one window to the next, and it says yes.
The ESP32 stamps the time, like a parking ticket, and plays a two-tone siren.
One sensor, one screen, one buzzer. That's the whole guard.
Want to build things like this? Follow the channel, and tell me what you would guard.
